name: St. Louis County Board of Elections

election.feed_election_id: St. Louis County media.csv, Nov 3, 2026 general

feed.results_url_note: The county's only readable results address tonight is this CSV (a 6.6 MB download); its office site stlouiscountymo.gov refused scripted reads in capture round 1, so no friendlier page is known.
feed.identity_note: Answered our named User-Agent on Nov 3, 10:19 PM CT (200, Last-Modified 03:58:42 GMT) and a conditional read at 10:20 PM (304).
feed.election_id_from: The file names no election. Its Last-Modified must fall between Nov 3 and certification, and it must hold the contests below by id and title (only this election has them).

count_closes_note: Mail had to arrive by 7 PM Nov 3; provisional ballots are added before the canvass, so the count stays open to certification.
